statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The Nasdaq-100 is holding a contained two-sided range with both session extremes rejected and retracements intact, while Stress stays elevated on the after-close Nvidia catalyst.
recommendation: Tail at 13 is well below the block threshold, so the deterministic mapping yields EA_ON. A narrow evidence-based danger window is published for 20:00-23:00 UTC, covering the Nvidia results at approximately 20:20 UTC and the 21:00 UTC conference call.
headline: Two-sided Nasdaq-100 range holds mid-band into Nvidia's after-close report; Tail low, Stress elevated
body: At the assessment cutoff the Nasdaq-100 cash index trades near 29,180, down about 0.10%, inside a 29,097-29,265 session range against a 29,209 previous close and a 29,131 open. Price sits close to the midpoint of that band after both the session low and the session high were made and rejected, so retracements are demonstrably occurring and no persistent one-way structure is observed. VIX near 15.5 is effectively unchanged with a narrow 15.41-15.74 range. The 2-year yield at about 4.22% and the 10-year at about 4.65% are each roughly one basis point higher, which is not a yield-led equity impulse. Crude is lower for a third session, with Brent and WTI reported down about 2.5% and 2.4% respectively in early trade after Iran and Oman set out a temporary joint maritime corridor and mine-clearing plan for the Strait of Hormuz; that removes rather than adds a geopolitical amplifier. July PCE printed slightly hot on the headline at 0.2% month-over-month and 3.7% year-over-year, while core matched consensus at 0.2% and 3.3%; durable goods orders beat at 1.1%, and the second estimate of Q2 GDP was in line at 1.5%. The dominant scheduled catalyst is Nvidia's fiscal Q2 2027 report, with results verified for approximately 20:20 UTC and the conference call for 21:00 UTC. Delayed latest-session cross-asset context shows megacaps split three higher against five lower and only one of seven large semiconductors higher, which is mixed rather than aligned; that context is supporting evidence only and is not treated as live price-path structure. Consistent with the published risk definitions, event importance and forecast dispersion are scored into Stress and Confidence rather than into Tail until an actual price path is observed.

lookbackSummary: Over the past 24 hours Claude's published Tail stayed inside a 9-16 band and never reached a blocking level. Risk drifted lower through the 25 August US afternoon and overnight to a trough of 9, then held near 11 through the European morning while Stress climbed steadily from 45 to 57 as the July PCE release and the after-close Nvidia catalyst approached. The 12:00 UTC slot carried the release window at Tail 16 with an event/whipsaw mode; the 13:00 and 14:00 UTC slots then showed Stress easing back to 52-54 and Tail settling at 14-15 as the post-release path proved orderly.
outlookSummary: The published path holds Tail in the low teens through the quiet US afternoon, lifts it to a 22-24 band across the 20:00-23:00 UTC window that covers Nvidia's after-close results and conference call, then normalizes it back toward 12-13 through the Asian and European overnight hours. The maximum forecast Tail of 24 keeps the deterministic mapping at WATCH and never reaches the block threshold, because pre-event dispersion is scored as Stress rather than as an already-observed price path. A modest step up to 14-16 is published for the 27 August 12:30 UTC jobless-claims block and the following US cash open, which also carries the first full cash-session verdict on Nvidia.
